name: ds michael furniture
old_description: Amazing in every way. Great guys to produce luxury furniture at a reasonable price. Found them through a friend of a friend introduced me. Would check them out if you're looking for higher end pieces or collections.
about:
DS Michael Furniture operates from Phoenix, Arizona. The company was founded by David (surname not disclosed) and has established itself as a supplier of custom furniture for the hospitality sector.

The shop produces custom furniture, cabinetry, contract upholstery, case goods, and wall beds. Its capabilities cover both design and manufacturing, with testimonials noting the team’s ability to handle large-scale projects such as tables, chairs, and booths for commercial venues. The facility has been described as expanding over time, though specific square footage and headcount are not public.

The client base centers on luxury hospitality, including hotels and restaurants. Completed projects include the Hotel Valley Ho in Phoenix, Fat Ox in Scottsdale, Momotaro in Chicago, and the Ritz‑Carlton Laguna Niguel. The company also lists Airbnb and Alta CA among its project references.

Clients cite the firm’s attention to manufacturing correctness, willingness to expand capacity, and ease of collaboration as reasons for repeat business. The company positions itself as a source for higher‑end pieces at a reasonable price point.
